verdict.rationale: Warp documents a built-in agent you can hand work to. It writes code, runs commands and iterates until the task is done, plans multi-step tasks, drives interactive programs, and supports follow-ups, prompt queueing and parallel conversations. Community users corroborate delegating real tasks to it, such as finding and assessing old unused files. missing for 10: consistent reliability evidence, since a Pro user reports random failures and agents stopping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what you want to build and let Warp's built‑in agent handle the rest — writing code, running commands, and iterating until the task is done.
The Warp Agent helps you investigate issues, edit code, run commands, and complete multi-step work.
The agent runs shell commands, reads live output, and drives interactive programs like REPLs, database shells, and full-screen apps.
you can run multiple Agent Mode conversations simultaneously in different windows, tabs, or panes.
